description: This file contains SQL schema definitions, indexes, function implementations, and query templates related to Orleans grain state storage in PostgreSQL. It defines the 'OrleansStorage' table, associated indexes, and an important stored procedure 'writetostorage' for updating and inserting grain states, along with query templates for reading, writing, and clearing storage.

methods.name: writetostorage
methods.description: A stored procedure that updates or inserts grain state data into the OrleansStorage table, ensuring concurrency control via versioning. It handles both updating existing grain state and inserting new state entries, with logic to manage race conditions and consistency.
